name: doobers-r4b
note: Doobers round 4b (owner, 2026-11-06): round 4 redrawn; the owner found too many items at an angle (Magic Mushroom, Bacon). Rule from here on: try STRAIGHT ON first, an angle only where the front view loses the geometry. The camera paragraph now sits in every sheet prompt and names the view per item.

wild.prompt: CONTROL: the first attached sheet on magenta is this game's APPROVED doober set: match its rendering, outline weight, simplicity, daylight, colours and item size within the cell EXACTLY, so every sheet is one set. CAMERA, NOT negotiable and the same as every other piece of this game's art: each item is seen STRAIGHT FROM THE FRONT, flat-on, as if it stood on a shelf at eye level facing the viewer, its front face parallel to the picture plane; NO three-quarter turn, NO top-down tilt, NO perspective, NO foreshortened top faces; round things are circles, flat things are flat to the viewer, symmetrical things are drawn symmetrically. Only where a pure front view would hide what the thing is may it be tipped the smallest amount needed, never more. SUBJECTS, nine items in order on the 3 x 3 grid, left to right then top to bottom, each straight from the front: 1 FEVERFEW: a sprig of three small white daisy-like flowers with yellow centres, faces to the viewer, feathery leaves below. 2 DAISY: one big white daisy, its face flat to the viewer, on a short stem with a leaf. 3 MAGIC MUSHROOM: one mushroom standing upright, cap seen from the front as a red dome with white spots, stem straight below, no tilt, no glow. 4 MULBERRY LEAF: one broad heart-shaped green leaf, flat to the viewer, toothed edges, stem down. 5 COFFEE CHERRY: a short upright sprig with red coffee cherries and two leaves, flat to the viewer. 6 BEANS: a low heap of dried speckled beans seen from the front. 7 OYSTER: one oyster shell, closed, its ribbed outer face flat to the viewer. 8 MEAT: a cut of red meat on a bone, flat to the viewer like a butcher's sign. 9 FISH: one plump silver-blue fish in pure side view, flat to the viewer.
